Synthetic Noise Downgrade Calibration

This fixture includes a synchronous render-blocking stylesheet in the document head. Under naive static analysis rules, render-blocking resources trigger a warning deduction. However, empirical paint timing confirms first contentful paint occurs at 620ms and largest contentful paint at 1,450ms.

Corroboration Behavior

The CwvRealityGatePolicy evaluates live paint timings against the static render-blocking warning.
